title: Sites
description: Named locations grouped by map. Missions reference sites by name so they stay portable across buildings.

file.description: Absolute path of the map .yaml on the robot (used by nav.change_map).

request_topic.description: ros.request steps asked at this site publish here, unless the step names its own topic.

answer_topic.description: ros.request steps asked at this site wait for answers here, unless the step names its own topic.

edges.description: The route graph for this map. Nodes are the sites above; an edge is a lane the robot is allowed to drive. Missions that use nav.follow_route only travel along these edges.

bidirectional.description: false makes it one-way, from -> to.

speed_mps.description: Optional cap while driving this lane.

blocked.description: Temporarily closed; the planner routes around it.

cost.description: Multiplies the length when choosing a route (1 = neutral).

zones.description: Named areas drawn on this map. They are exported as Nav2 costmap filter masks and can be read from mission expressions with in_zone('name').

kind.description: keepout: the planner may not enter. speed_limit: the controller is capped at speed_mps inside. preferred: drawn only, for the operator. work: a named area used by missions and expressions.

polygon.description: Closed polygon in map coordinates, [[x, y], ...].

speed_mps.description: speed_limit zones: the cap inside the polygon.
